unit_cn: Unit 3 Environmental Protection 环境保护
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 3 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、环保(气候变化/碳排放/可持续发展/环保行动/塞罕坝/绿色生活)主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Water conservation has greatly improved the river's quality.
words.example_cn: 水资源保护极大改善了这条河的水质。

words.example_en: We must cut carbon emissions to slow down climate change.
words.example_cn: 我们必须减少碳排放以减缓气候变化。

words.example_en: Clean energy helps us build a sustainable future.
words.example_cn: 清洁能源帮助我们建设一个可持续的未来。

words.example_en: A healthy environment can sustain life for many years.
words.example_cn: 健康的环境能维持生命许多年。

words.example_en: Burning fossil fuels releases harmful gases into the air.
words.example_cn: 燃烧化石燃料会向空气中排放有害气体。

words.example_en: Coal and oil are the main fuels that pollute the air.
words.example_cn: 煤和石油是污染空气的主要燃料。

words.example_en: Cars produce a lot of carbon dioxide every day.
words.example_cn: 汽车每天排放大量二氧化碳。

words.example_en: Factories release waste gases that harm the environment.
words.example_cn: 工厂排放有害环境的废气。

words.meaning_cn: 烟雾(烟与雾混合的空气污染物)
words.example_en: Heavy smog made it hard to see across the city.
words.example_cn: 浓重的烟雾让人难以看清整座城市。

words.example_en: Tourists should never throw garbage into the river.
words.example_cn: 游客绝不应往河里扔垃圾。

words.example_en: New rules were made about garbage disposal in the village.
words.example_cn: 村里制定了关于垃圾处理的新规定。

words.example_en: Urgent steps were taken to restore the river's beauty.
words.example_cn: 人们采取紧急措施来修复这条河的美景。

words.example_en: The government decided to restrict the use of plastic bags.
words.example_cn: 政府决定限制塑料袋的使用。

words.meaning_cn: 限制规定;限制法规;约束
words.example_en: Vehicle restriction has helped reduce smog in big cities.
words.example_cn: 限行措施帮助减少了大城市的烟雾。

words.example_en: The villagers now live in a harmonious way with nature.
words.example_cn: 村民们如今与自然和谐相处。

words.example_en: Planting trees helps protect the local ecology.
words.example_cn: 植树有助于保护当地的生态。

words.example_en: The villagers could no longer tolerate the dirty air.
words.example_cn: 村民们再也无法忍受污浊的空气。

words.example_en: Many polar bears may starve as the ice melts away.
words.example_cn: 随着冰雪融化,许多北极熊可能会挨饿。

words.example_en: As the earth gets warmer, the ice begins to melt.
words.example_cn: 随着地球变暖,冰雪开始融化。

words.example_en: Rising temperatures are a worrying trend for our planet.
words.example_cn: 气温上升对我们的星球来说是一个令人担忧的趋势。

words.example_en: A comprehensive plan was started to clean up the river.
words.example_cn: 人们启动了一项全面的计划来清理河流。

words.example_en: The city worked hard to implement the new green policy.
words.example_cn: 这座城市努力贯彻新的环保政策。

words.example_en: A good energy policy can reduce carbon emissions.
words.example_cn: 好的能源政策能减少碳排放。

words.example_en: Strict regulations stopped the factories from polluting.
words.example_cn: 严格的规章制度阻止了工厂污染。

words.example_en: An energy reform encouraged people to use clean power.
words.example_cn: 一项能源改革鼓励人们使用清洁能源。

words.example_en: Dozens of polluting enterprises were closed or moved.
words.example_cn: 数十家污染企业被关闭或迁走。

words.example_en: Officials carry out inspections to find pollution problems.
words.example_cn: 官员们进行检查以发现污染问题。

words.example_en: The local authorities fine companies that pollute the river.
words.example_cn: 当地政府对污染河流的公司处以罚款。

words.example_en: We must seize the chance to protect our environment now.
words.example_cn: 我们必须抓住机会现在就保护环境。

words.example_en: Students will submit a report on water pollution next week.
words.example_cn: 学生们下周将提交一份关于水污染的报告。

words.meaning_cn: 敏感的;善解人意的;灵敏的
words.example_en: Nuclear power is a sensitive topic for many people.
words.example_cn: 核能对许多人来说是一个敏感话题。

words.example_en: Moderate use of energy at home saves both money and power.
words.example_cn: 家中适度用能既省钱又省电。

words.example_en: Riding a bike helps to lower your carbon footprint.
words.example_cn: 骑自行车有助于降低你的碳足迹。

words.example_en: The word 'smog' originated in Britain long ago.
words.example_cn: smog 这个词很久以前起源于英国。

words.example_en: Many visitors frequently threw rubbish into the water.
words.example_cn: 许多游客经常往水里扔垃圾。

words.meaning_cn: 原子能的;核能的;原子核的
words.example_en: Some people worry that nuclear power is not safe.
words.example_cn: 有些人担心核能不安全。

words.example_en: Cattle farms release a lot of methane into the air.
words.example_cn: 养牛场向空气中排放大量甲烷。

words.example_en: Cutting down tropical forests harms the whole planet.
words.example_cn: 砍伐热带森林危害整个星球。

words.example_en: Many rare animals live deep in the thick jungle.
words.example_cn: 许多珍稀动物生活在茂密的丛林深处。

words.example_en: Pollution in the river basin affects millions of people.
words.example_cn: 河流流域的污染影响着数百万人。

words.example_en: China's waterways are heading towards a cleaner future.
words.example_cn: 中国的水道正迈向更清洁的未来。

words.example_en: We must keep the earth a habitable planet for all life.
words.example_cn: 我们必须让地球保持适合一切生命居住。

words.example_en: The annual report showed that the air quality had improved.
words.example_cn: 年度报告显示空气质量已经改善。

words.example_en: A clean-up campaign was added to the government agenda.
words.example_cn: 一项清理行动被列入了政府的议事日程。

words.example_en: The graph shows how carbon emissions have risen each year.
words.example_cn: 这张图表显示了碳排放如何逐年上升。

words.meaning_cn: 世界各地的;遍及全球地
words.example_en: Climate change is a serious worldwide problem today.
words.example_cn: 气候变化是当今一个严重的全球性问题。
